visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen displays two women. The woman on the left, with dark hair in a white camisole, is washing her hair in a tiled bathroom. The woman on the right, in a brown top, is brushing her long dark hair in a bedroom setting. Both appear stressed. (2) Close-up on the left woman's head as she massages white shampoo foam into her hair. (3) The right woman is shown lying in bed under a white blanket; a digital clock graphic shows 3:00 AM. Suddenly, the clock shifts to 8:00 AM, and she wakes up in a panic. (4) The scene cuts to the left woman also waking up abruptly to an 8:00 AM alarm. She is then seen brushing her teeth and hair simultaneously in a frantic montage. (5) A transition effect with soft glowing light occurs, showing the left woman's hair looking smooth and shiny as she walks outside. (6) The right woman is seen at a table, holding a phone to her ear and brushing her hair. (7) The left woman is at an outdoor breakfast stall, looking through her bag hurriedly while ordering food. (8) Both women are now in a studio setting with a grey background, appearing together for an audition. They bow and greet a 'director' sitting in a chair wearing a cap. (9) Both women hold up large bottles of 'Hair Recipe' shampoo—one green and one ginger-colored. They point to the products with excited facial expressions. (10) Extreme close-ups show the liquid shampoo being pumped into a hand and lathered onto the scalp. (11) A side-by-side 'Before' and 'After' comparison shows the left woman with oily, flat hair vs. voluminous, shiny hair. (12) The two women dance and toss their hair happily in the studio to conclude.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music begins. Two female voices are heard simultaneously in a split-mix, speaking with high arousal about an upcoming audition. (2) A sharp alarm clock beep triggers a shift to frantic, rapid speech. The voices exhibit vocal tension and a high speech rate. (3) Frequent 'Whoosh' sound effects accompany visual scene changes. A cartoonish 'Pop' sound occurs during hair highlights. (4) Background ambient noise of a busy street stall is briefly audible beneath the dominant dialogue. (5) A clear 'Ding' bell sound effect marks the presentation of the product. The tone becomes more persuasive and melodic. (6) Heavy synthesizer beats swell as the women dance, with perfectly synced rhythmic cuts in the master audio track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Hair Recipe shampoo products by demonstrating their effectiveness in maintaining good hair appearance despite a stressful, rushed morning routine.
